<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919159_theRebbe_441" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919159_theRebbe_441__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The difference between the service of testimonies and the service of statutes parallels the difference between them in the mitzvos themselves, where the essential will is for the mitzvos themselves, not for any purpose they accomplish.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, the difference between the service of testimonies and the service of statutes is analogous to the difference between them regarding the mitzvos themselves.</t>
    <t s="2">This will be understood based on the known principle</t>
    <t s="3">that the will for mitzvos as it is from the aspect of Atzmus is an essential will that is not for the sake of any purpose that is accomplished through the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="4">and the purpose of mitzvos</t>
    <t s="5">(from the perspective of this will)</t>
    <t s="6">is the mitzvos themselves.</t>
    <t s="7">From this it is understood</t>
    <t s="8">that the fact that mitzvos draw down and reveal the Atzmus of Ein Sof in the world,</t>
    <t s="9">even though the drawing down is from the aspect that mitzvos are His will that is above reason,</t>
    <t s="10">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="11">since this is a matter that is accomplished through the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="12">it is analogous to a reason.</t>
    <t s="13">And the true essence of the matter of the essential will of His Atzmus is in the mitzvos themselves.</t>
    <t s="14">And this is why the service of testimonies is the service of ratzusa deliba (desire of the heart), and the service of statutes is the service of kabbalas ol (acceptance of the yoke),</t>
    <t s="15">for the matter of testimony in mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="16">since it is a drawing down and revelation,</t>
    <t s="17">the vessel for this is will,</t>
    <t s="18">for even the will that is from the aspect of the essence of the soul is a movement of drawing down and spreading forth</t>
    <t s="19">(existence),</t>
    <t s="20">and the vessel for the matter of statutes of mitzvos, which is the essential will itself that is above revelation, is the self-nullification of kabbalas ol,</t>
    <t s="21">a self-nullification from the aspect of the essence that is above any matter of spreading forth.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Dovid's statement "Your statutes were songs to me" specifically negates not only the level of ordinances but also testimonies, because in the level of testimonies there still remains some existence, both from the human side and from the mitzvos themselves.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is</t>
    <t s="2">"Your statutes were songs to me"</t>
    <t s="3">(specifically),</t>
    <t s="4">for his intention in this is to negate not only the matter of ordinances but also the matter of testimonies.</t>
    <t s="5">For in the level of testimonies there still remains some existence.</t>
    <t s="6">And not only from the human side,</t>
    <t s="7">for even his will that is above intellect and reason</t>
    <t s="8">(desire of the heart)</t>
    <t s="9">is an existence</t>
    <t s="10">(as above),</t>
    <t s="11">but also from the side of the mitzvos that are in the level of testimonies,</t>
    <t s="12">since their matter is the drawing down and revelation of Ein Sof in the world.</t>
    <t s="13">And the true and complete recognition that all worlds are nullified in existence relative to one detail of Torah is specifically in the level of statutes,</t>
    <t s="14">for the details of Torah</t>
    <t s="15">(from the aspect of this level)</t>
    <t s="16">are an essential matter from the aspect of their essential root in Torah,</t>
    <t s="17">which is above any connection to the world.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The continuation explains that Dovid was punished for engaging in Torah in a way of "singing to the mighty" because the ultimate purpose is "to settle it," to engage in the work of refinement and draw down light into the world, which is the advantage of prayer over Torah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">11)</t>
    <t s="1">a)</t>
    <t s="2">And the maamar continues,</t>
    <t s="3">that the reason Dovid was punished for this</t>
    <t s="4">is because Dovid's engagement in Torah was in a manner of "singing to the mighty"</t>
    <t s="5">(as above),</t>
    <t s="6">and the ultimate purpose is as it is written,</t>
    <t s="7">"He did not create it for chaos, He formed it to be settled,"</t>
    <t s="8">to engage in the work of refining sparks and to draw down the revelation of light in the world.</t>
    <t s="9">For this is the advantage of prayer over Torah,</t>
    <t s="10">that prayer is refinement and elevation,</t>
    <t s="11">meaning that through prayer the sparks are refined, purified, and ascend upward,</t>
    <t s="12">unlike Torah, which is a drawing down from above,</t>
    <t s="13">and the refinement through Torah is in a manner of pushing aside.</t>
    <t s="14">And when Dovid wanted to refine sparks through Torah,</t>
    <t s="15">which is in a manner of pushing aside,</t>
    <t s="16">to "sing to the mighty,"</t>
    <t s="17">he was punished for this,</t>
    <t s="18">because the ultimate purpose is "to settle it."</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
